name: Maximiliana Featherstonehaugh-Cholmondeley von Wolkenstein-Trostburg
headline: Fictional principal engineer who designs, builds and patiently maintains dependable software for freight forwarding, warehouse operations, cross-border customs paperwork and the small internal tools that hold such long, interconnected processes together
shortBio: Maximiliana is a **fictional** person from the website's browser tests, whose every text is as long as the contract allows a real one to be, so that each page shows how it wraps names, addresses and identifiers such as `consolidated_freight_dispatch_reconciliation_job` that cannot break at a space.
location: Fictional Harbour District, Testville upon the Long River, Republic of Examples

servicesIntro: Maximiliana turns *fictional* manual work in freight forwarding, warehouse operations and customs paperwork into dependable software that small teams can keep running themselves.

collaborationSteps.title: Understand the whole process before proposing anything
collaborationSteps.description: A long conversation about the **fictional** process from the first order to the last invoice, including every exception the team handles by hand.

collaborationSteps.title: Agree on a written scope with assumptions and an estimate
collaborationSteps.description: A written scope that names the approach, every assumption and what is deliberately left out.

servicesNote: Software delivery for logistics is Maximiliana's long-standing practice; the AI work is a newer focus, shown as independent R&D and never as delivered client work.
